rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and zip, matched to a single user via the tool. It retrieved the specified delivered order and item details, checked product variant availability with read-only product tools, and presented accurate available options. Before making any changes, the agent asked for explicit confirmation of the exact exchange items. After user confirmation, it executed the exchange on the correct order and account, using the stored payment method, and the tool confirmed status changed to “exchange requested” with the correct new item IDs and a negative price difference (refund). The final message reflected the confirmed changes and correctly stated that a refund would be issued, consistent with the tool’s negative price difference. No fabrications or policy violations are evident.
